title: Maine authorizes a Pulpit Harbor toll bridge to Beverage family land
description: A Maine act established the North Haven Bridge Company and authorized a toll bridge over the head of Pulpit Harbor from Enos Cooper’s land to land belonging to James and Josiah Beverage. The act proves the property relationship and proposed infrastructure; it does not by itself prove that the bridge was ultimately built.
evidence_status: Verified authorization in official Maine law; completion not asserted
